name: Shidou Suzuka
source: Yuma's overly excited and childish upperclassmate. She fell in love with Yuma on the day of the entrance ceremony and has followed him around since. Often sneaks into his room and even his bed wearing very little hoping to entice him. She even goes so far as giving him blowjobs. When she's selected for the "Sex Royale" she's so excited she can hardly contain herself. Yuma must be careful whenever he's around Suzuka as she will happily rape him if given the slightest opportunity and earning points for the female team. However, she is just as happy at being 'raped' by Yuma instead.
